title: School Transformation: A step towards quality education
summary: 14 volunteers joined hands to transform a government primary school in Tehri into a vibrant learning space.
description: 14 volunteers joined hands to transform a government primary school in Tehri into a vibrant learning space. In collaboration with UP India, the initiative impacted 185 students by improving classroom infrastructure, hygiene conditions, and digital access – creating an inspiring environment for holistic learning.
